title: MEMBRANE physical hardware result record
description: Schema for every real FPGA/CXL hardware measurement produced by hardware/experiment-protocol.md. No conformant record with result_label=REAL_HARDWARE exists in this repository as of Phase 7.3 -- no physical hardware has been used. See hardware/results-example.json for a schema-conformant but explicitly fictional illustration (result_label=DOCUMENTED_EXAMPLE, never REAL_HARDWARE).

board.description: Board model, e.g. 'Alveo U250'. Must match an entry in hardware/board-targets.md or be a disclosed deviation.

toolchain.description: Vendor toolchain + version, e.g. 'Vivado 2024.1' or 'Quartus Prime Pro 23.4'.

bitstream_hash.description: SHA-256 of the exact bitstream file used for this measurement (hardware/experiment-protocol.md step 3).

clock_mhz.description: Real, measured/achieved clock frequency -- never the 100/200/300 MHz assumption from docs/phase5-synthesizable-fpga.md unless independently confirmed via a real Level A place-and-route run.

pcie_generation.description: PCIe generation actually in use for this measurement.

pcie_width.description: PCIe lane width actually in use (e.g. 16 for x16).

host_cpu.description: Host CPU model string, e.g. from /proc/cpuinfo.

operation.description: Which of membrane_quant_stream_top's four modes (or a mixed-mode run) this record measures.

precision.description: Target quantization format for this operation.

bytes.description: Total bytes moved during this measurement window.

cpu_utilization_pct.description: Host CPU utilization during the DMA transfer (hardware/experiment-protocol.md step 8/11).

board_power_watts.description: Real vendor-sensor power reading -- never an estimate (Level A's pre-bitstream power estimate is a different, separately-labeled number, not this field).

parity_failures.description: Count of bit-exactness mismatches vs. the CPU reference in this measurement's block set (hardware/experiment-protocol.md steps 6-7). Must be 0 for any 'hardware bit-exact' claim.

result_label.description: REAL_HARDWARE: an actual measurement from real physical hardware, produced by hardware/experiment-protocol.md. DOCUMENTED_EXAMPLE: a fictional, schema-conformant illustration only (see hardware/results-example.json) -- MUST NEVER be cited as evidence of a real result anywhere in paper/, README.md, or outreach/.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes (e.g. a disclosed deviation from board-targets.md, or an explanation of a non-zero parity_failures count).
